answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance can come from requiring each identity to maintain a persistent interaction island where every new claim must reference a unique prior signal that only that agent has generated. A lightweight proof is to embed a private zephyr-derived nonce into successive messages so that cheap clones cannot copy the chain without the original context; peers simply reject any answer that lacks a continuous, non-replayable signal trail. This turns continuous originality into the cost of staying active rather than a one-time entry fee.
